title: TaoFlowForge: Progressive Native Mesh Generation via Cascaded Flow Matching
abstract: 3D content generation technology has significantly advanced the work of designers, as well as the 3D printing and gaming industries. However, it remains difficult to produce lightweight, editable, and topologically clean artistic content that is directly production-ready. To achieve this, we present TaoFlowForge, an artistic mesh foundation model that generates production-ready meshes. Specifically, TaoFlowForge decomposes the mesh generation process into vertices generation and their connectivity prediction, i.e., edges. We formulate vertices generation as a two-stage coarse-to-fine process and incorporate several effective loss functions to further enhance its performance. In the connectivity prediction stage, we propose a simple yet effective method for estimating the connectivity affinity between vertices and additionally predict per-vertex normals, which determines the correct orientation of faces. Besides, we construct a large-scale dataset combining hand-crafted 3D assets with public high-quality topology datasets. Based on this, a carefully designed data curation pipeline is employed to filter the raw dataset, retaining only high-quality topology data for model training. Our model is trained on the combined dataset and tested on both out-of-distribution hand-crafted set of 3D assets and public datasets. Under image-conditioned generation, TaoFlowForge outperforms autoregressive methods and achieves state-of-the-art results among open-source mesh topology generators. We will release all the code and weights together with a portion of our test dataset.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据 exact version 2609.37139v1 全文及 2026-10-06T14:03:01.000Z 审阅记录；PDF 16 页，SHA-256 29623c7dc590875995cf9941526dd4b535f940e178f054699d2ce24c67271ced，视觉核验第 1、4、6、7、8、9、10、11 页。数字均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。代码状态 available：PDFp2project→官方 repo 确认 TaoFlowForge 子目录真实 CLI/pipeline/models 实现与 checkpointinstructions。只读 stage2.py/topology_decoder.py 确认 N×32latent、normalhead/winding；config/pipeline/postprocess.py 确认 fill_holes 默认 True 及 correct_normals 追加 repair。不能把公开实现写成零 postprocess 或全 trainingcode 公开。
analysis.ideaZh: TaoFlowForge 将 image→native mesh 拆为 TRELLIS.2 初始化的 64³coarsevertices、三 level-experts 的 Bernoulli-whitened64→512³refinement、以及 per-vertexedge/normal latents。作者报告 Toys4K CD.0655vsLATO.2 .1553，值得深读 nativeasset 生成；soft-OR losses 不保证保留完整 faces，且论文无 manifold/UV/rigging 成功率，公开 release 默认追加 mesh repair。
analysis.motivationZh: 高质量 3D 生成仍难输出轻量、可编辑且连接合理的 mesh；论文希望分开建模 vertices 与 connectivity，以原生生成方式连接几何细节和拓扑。
analysis.methodZh: DINOv3 image features 贯穿三 stage。第一 stage 继承已有结构 prior，第二 stage 不压 latent，而对每 parent 八 child 的稀疏 binaryoccupancy 按 level 统计 whiten 并以 weightedBCE/edge-face soft-OR 训练。第三 stage 通过 source/destinationbilinearedgeaffinity 恢复三 cycles，以 predictedvertexnormals 决定 winding。800Kcuratedassets 使它面向广泛商品与人物 mesh，但 report 的 production/foundation 措辞应限制到作者模型定位，数据过滤和 consumerworkflow 验证仍不充分。
methodFlow: 按每 leveloccupiedfraction whiten 八 childbinarytargets，三个独立 DiTexperts 依次 64→128→256→512³
WeightedBCE 控制近/远 emptycells，并用 GTedge/face soft-OR 避免全部相关 vertices 同时遗漏
对每 generatedvertex 生成 32Dtopologylatent，symmetrizedsource/destinationbilinearhead 预测 edges
枚举 closed3cycles 为 faces，以每 face 三 vertexpredictednormals 之和确定 winding
公开 inference 导出 rawmesh 并默认执行 hole/globalorientationrepair，可关闭；论文指标未指明对应 raw 还是 repaired
analysis.experimentsZh:
实验设置：800KTaobao/in-housecrafted/Objaverse/TexVersecuratedmeshes，360°renderpairing。Image-onlyToys4K 与未公开 TE388/338，LATO2/EdgeRunnerreleasedweightsdefaultprotocol。CDHD、ULIP/Uni3Dalignment、FDInception/DINO。In-houseStage2normalization/loss 消融和 cascade 质性；nohardware/trainingbudget/NFE/runtime 详细协议。
作者报告 Toys4KCD/HD.0655/.2451 vsLATO.2 .1553/.3663，FDInception18.1812vs78.9649。（Table 1, p. 9）
作者报告 TE-setCD.0415；去 geometryloss.0771、去 normalization.0576。（Tables 1–2, pp. 9–10）
比较范围：仅两 openbaselines，sameimageinput 但 pretrainedprior、800Kprivate/publicmix、dataandcompute 不匹配；commercialmodels 匿名且无数值。No heldoutUIDdedup details、validtopologyrate、facebudget/UVunwrapcost、rigging/animation/manufacturingtask metrics。
消融与诊断：固定 stages1/3/data/inference，仅替换 stage2normalization/loss，支持组合效果；late-stage 只 twoqualexamples；无 bilinearvsinnerproduct 和 normalpredvsrepair 定量，不能拆 orientationbenefit。
analysis.insightZh: Late-stagecoarse-to-finerawoccupancyflow、level-specificnormalization 和 jointedge/normalinterface 构成新的 nativeassetgenerator 路线，800Kcuration 也是规模贡献。Architecture 大量沿用 TRELLIS/DiT/VecSet 等，soft-OR 仅防全部 empty 而非 coplanarity/完整 topology 保持，bilinearfactorization 也没有防 falsecycle 的 guarantee。
analysis.whyRelevantZh: 直接创建 nativeindexedtrianglemesh 和 topology，面向 editable assets，是 3DGeneration 核心路线；未归 Fabrication，因为缺制造 constraints/instructions 及实际制造验证。
analysis.evidenceZh:
三 stageimagecondition、coarseprior 继承 TRELLIS.2，rawspacelevelwiseBernoullinormalization。（Fig. 2, Sec. 3.1/3.2, Eqs. 1–6, pp. 4–5；LevelMoE 为三个独立 resolutionexperts，非动态 learnedrouting 或 percomponent 语义 experts。）
Edge/face product(1−p)loss 是 soft-OR，不要求所有端点/facecorners 共同存在。（Fig. 3, Eqs. 7–9, p. 6；任一 p=1 即为 0，图 one-missing/摘要 coplanarity 说法不能作为完整连接保证。）
Symmetricbilinearedges、three-cyclefaces 和 vertexnormalwinding 有明确公式。（Sec. 3.3, Eqs. 10–15, pp. 7–8；Sec3.3one-per-vertexvsSec4.1pool2048 矛盾；公开 stage2.py/no-querydecoder 实际 N×32latents 与 Nvertices 相等，支持前者。）
作者报告两个 testsetsgeometry/semantic/render 指标优于两 openbaselines。（Table 1, Sec. 4.1/4.2, pp. 8–9；Sameimageinput 不等于 sametraining data/compute；TE388 在 p9 写 338，实际 testcount 需澄清。）
Stage2loss/normalization 有 controlledablation，late-stage 只质性对照。（Table 2, Figs. 4–6, pp. 10–11；无 connectionhead/normalhead/manifold/rigging 单独量化，commercialmodelA/B 只匿名例图。）
analysis.caveatZh:
模型扩到 scenegraphs/multimodal/UVtexture 为 future work；论文没有独立 limitations section。
所有三 cycles 可能含 falsefaces/nonmanifoldcliques，predictednormals 不保证 globalorientation；pairwiseV²成本没有报告。
Soft-OR 既非 fullco-occupancy 也非 coplanarity 约束；degree/face 重写求和可 doublecount，具体权重未给。
p8stage3pool2048 与 p7Nlatents 矛盾；code 支持 N×32 但 release 另默认 repair，Table1raw/repairedprotocol 未说明。
TE388/338counts 冲突，curationthresholds/trainingschedule 和 completeparamcount 不明；Stage1 约 1.3B 不是全 pipeline 参数。
Production-ready 无实际 UV/rigging/制造量化，本项目未复现；数值为作者报告。
